metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 2026 · The Day She Returns
metas.description: ​Having stepped back from acting after marriage and a subsequent divorce, actress Bae Jeongsu returns to the profession with a role in an independent film. As the film’s release approaches, she takes part in a series of press interviews, only to discover later, when asked to revisit those moments in her acting class, that she cannot clearly recall what was said.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 2008 · Funny Games
metas.description: Two psychopathic young men take a family hostage in their cabin.

metas.name: 2026 · The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
metas.description: Explores Panem 24 years before Katniss' saga, starting on the morning of the reaping for the 50th Hunger Games, where a young Haymitch Abernathy participates.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2016 · Orange
metas.description: High school student Naho Takamiya receives a letter from her future self that warns her to avoid mistakes she will make involving a new transfer student, Kakeru Naruse, a troubled boy whom she meets and begins to fall in love with.

metas.name: 2026 · Madden
metas.description: John Madden's remarkable journey-from a Super Bowl-winning partnership with Al Davis and the Raiders, to creating Madden NFL, and becoming one of the most iconic voices in football history.

metas.name: 2026 · The Bodyguard
metas.description: A skilled bodyguard is assigned to protect a reclusive movie star from a stalker and must pose as his girlfriend to keep the threat hidden. On his family ranch, the assignment blurs lines as proximity complicates the job.
Three intertwined timelines follow the planning and execution of a daring heist in Zurich and its aftermath as an FBI agent pursues a master criminal across Europe.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 2026 · Line of Fire
metas.description: A family of law enforcement agents become targets of a mysterious assassin after a U.S. Marshal falls in the line of duty, forcing them to use their expertise to protect each other.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2016 · My Annoying Brother
metas.description: A now-blind athlete must rely on his estranged brother, who may have just used him as an excuse to get himself out of jail. The two were never close, but brothers soon realize a connection they couldn't always see.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2022 · This Is Christmas
metas.description: This rom-com set in London during the Christmas season follows Adam and Emma on their daily commute from the village of Langton to London, where they meet the same passengers every day.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2026 · 100 Days of Deception
metas.description: Drama set during the Japanese colonial era, centring on a high-stakes undercover mission and an unexpected love story.

metas.name: ★ 6.0 · 2026 · Paradise Lost
metas.description: A bus full of children mysteriously vanishes. When an altered version of a grieving mother's son returns years later, she must grapple with the technologically revised reality she has created.

metas.name: 2026 · The Good Daughter
metas.description: The Quinn sisters, Samantha and Charlotte, have spent the last twenty-eight years trying to piece together the lives that were fractured by a single night of violence.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2026 · Club Kid
metas.description: A hard-partying New York City club promoter sees his whirlwind lifestyle upended by the arrival of the 10-year-old son he never knew he had.
